You have a DICOM folder of MRI and CT scans of one patient, taken at many different times. You have a JSON file that we think does two things: it gives the biopsy points in the coordinate system of one of those scans, and it gives a way to get from that scan's coordinate system to each of the others.

You also have one piece of ground truth: a screenshot from the navigation system, showing a biopsy point on the axial, coronal and sagittal slices of the MRI. Whatever answer we reach has to put the point in the same place as the screenshot.

import pydicom
import glob, os
from collections import defaultdict

folder = "/home/lj/Desktop/neuman-benchmark/patient-folder"
files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(folder, "*.dcm")))
print("total files:", len(files))

# group by (study, series)
groups = defaultdict(list)
for f in files:
    ds = pydicom.dcmread(f, stop_before_pixels=True)
    study = str(ds.get("StudyInstanceUID"))
    series = str(ds.get("SeriesInstanceUID"))
    key = (study, series)
    groups[key].append((f, ds))

print("num series:", len(groups))
print()
for (study, series), items in sorted(groups.items()):
    ds = items[0][1]
    print("STUDY", study, " SERIES", series)
    print("  n_slices:", len(items))
    print("  Modality:", ds.get("Modality"))
    print("  SeriesDesc:", ds.get("SeriesDescription"))
    print("  ImageType:", ds.get("ImageType"))
    print("  PixelSpacing:", ds.get("PixelSpacing"))
    print("  SliceThickness:", ds.get("SliceThickness"))
    print("  Rows/Cols:", ds.get("Rows"), ds.get("Columns"))
    print("  ImagePositionPatient (first file):", ds.get("ImagePositionPatient"))
    print("  ImageOrientationPatient:", ds.get("ImageOrientationPatient"))
    print("  PatientPosition:", ds.get("PatientPosition"))
    print()

import pydicom, glob, os
import numpy as np, json
from collections import defaultdict

def load_series(snum):
    dss=[pydicom.dcmread(f) for f in by_series[snum]]
    dss.sort(key=lambda d:d.InstanceNumber)
    arr=np.array([d.pixel_array for d in dss],dtype=np.float32)
    first=dss[0]
    iop=np.array(list(first.ImageOrientationPatient),float).reshape(2,3)
    ipp=np.array(list(first.ImagePositionPatient),float)
    row,col=iop[0],iop[1]; nrm=np.cross(row,col); nrm/=np.linalg.norm(nrm)
    zz=[np.array(list(d.ImagePositionPatient),float) for d in dss]
    proj=[(z-ipp)@nrm for z in zz]; sdir=nrm
    if max(proj)-min(proj)>1e-6:
        order=np.argsort(proj); p=np.array(proj)[order]; ss=float(np.median(np.diff(p)))
        sdir=nrm if ss>0 else -nrm
    px,py=[float(x) for x in first.PixelSpacing]
    return arr, (row,col,sdir,ipp,(px,py,float(np.median(np.diff(np.sort(proj)))) if max(proj)-min(proj)>1e-6 else float(first.SliceThickness)))

def load_series(snum):
    dss=[pydicom.dcmread(f) for f in by_series[snum]]
    dss.sort(key=lambda d:d.InstanceNumber)
    arr=np.array([d.pixel_array for d in dss],dtype=np.float32)
    first=dss[0]
    iop=np.array(list(first.ImageOrientationPatient),float).reshape(2,3)
    ipp=np.array(list(first.ImagePositionPatient),float)
    row,col=iop[0],iop[1]; nrm=np.cross(row,col); nrm/=np.linalg.norm(nrm)
    px,py=[float(x) for x in first.PixelSpacing]; ss=float(first.SliceThickness)
    return arr,(row,col,nrm,ipp,px,py,ss)

def mass_center_mm(arr,geo):
    """image-mm centroid of the brightest enhancing blob (largest connected component above a high threshold)."""
    row,col,nrm,ipp,px,py,ss=geo
    thr=np.percentile(arr,90)+0.5*(arr.max()-np.percentile(arr,90))
    mask=arr>thr
    lab,n=ndimage.label(mask)
    if n==0: return None
    sizes=ndimage.sum(np.ones_like(lab),lab,range(1,n+1))
    big=np.argmax(sizes)+1
    ys,xs,ssidx=np.where(lab==big)  # arr[slice,row,col]
    r=xs.mean(); c=ys.mean(); s=ssidx.mean()
    p=np.array([r*px, c*py, s*ss])  # image-mm (corner-anchored)
    return p

from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter, maximum_filter

folder="/home/lj/Desktop/neuman-benchmark/patient-folder"

for f in files:
    by_series[str(pydicom.dcmread(f,stop_before_pixels=True).get("SeriesNumber"))].append(f)

def load_series(snum):
    dss=[pydicom.dcmread(f) for f in by_series[snum]]
    dss.sort(key=lambda d:d.InstanceNumber)
    arr=np.array([d.pixel_array for d in dss],dtype=np.float32)  # [slice,row,col]
    first=dss[0]
    iop=np.array(list(first.ImageOrientationPatient),float).reshape(2,3)
    ipp=np.array(list(first.ImagePositionPatient),float)
    row,col=iop[0],iop[1]; nrm=np.cross(row,col); nrm/=np.linalg.norm(nrm)
    px,py=[float(x) for x in first.PixelSpacing]; ss=float(first.SliceThickness)
    return arr,(row,col,nrm,ipp,px,py,ss)

def brightest_core_mm(arr,geo,smooth=3.0):
    """image-mm location of the brightest region (smoothed argmax)."""
    row,col,nrm,ipp,px,py,ss=geo
    sm=gaussian_filter(arr,smooth)
    idx=np.unravel_index(np.argmax(sm),arr.shape)  # (slice,row,col)
    s,r,c=idx
    return np.array([c*px, r*py, s*ss])  # image-mm corner-anchored

import pydicom, glob, os
import numpy as np, json
from collections import defaultdict
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter

folder="/home/lj/Desktop/neuman-benchmark/patient-folder"
files=sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(folder,"*.dcm")))
by_series=defaultdict(list)
for f in files:
    by_series[str(pydicom.dcmread(f,stop_before_pixels=True).get("SeriesNumber"))].append(f)

def load(snum):
    dss=[pydicom.dcmread(f) for f in by_series[snum]]
    dss.sort(key=lambda d:d.InstanceNumber)
    arr=np.array([d.pixel_array for d in dss],dtype=np.float32)  # [slice,row,col]
    d0=dss[0]
    iop=np.array(list(d0.ImageOrientationPatient),float).reshape(2,3)
    ipp=np.array(list(d0.ImagePositionPatient),float)
    r,c=iop[0],iop[1]; n=np.cross(r,c); n/=np.linalg.norm(n)
    R=np.column_stack([r,c,n]); T=np.eye(4); T[:3,:3]=R; T[:3,3]=ipp
    px,py=[float(x) for x in d0.PixelSpacing]; ss=float(d0.SliceThickness)
    return arr,(R,ipp,px,py,ss)

# image-mm (volume-local) <-> voxel ; orientation-independent
def vox_of_mm(q,px,py,ss): return (q[0]/px, q[1]/py, q[2]/ss)
def mm_of_vox(vox,px,py,ss): return np.array([vox[0]*px, vox[1]*py, vox[2]*ss])

def mass_core_mm(arr,px,py,ss,guess_mm,ball_vox=22):

p1_RPI=np.array([89.44,60.20,66.00])    # plans.RPI  Plan1
p1_DCM=np.array([20.62,-49.90,12.00])   # plans.DCM  Plan1
def applyM(M,v): return (M@np.append(v,1.0))[:3]
print("  rpiTvolMM @ plans.LPS =",np.round(applyM(r2v,p1_LPS),3),"  (plans.RPI =",p1_RPI,")")
print("  dicomTvolMM @ plans.LPS =",np.round(applyM(d2v,p1_LPS),3),"  (plans.DCM =",p1_DCM,")")
print("  => 'A_TB' means  p_A = A_TB @ p_B  (transform from B to A).  CONFIRMED.\n")

print("=== CONSEQUENCE ===")

print("  =>  biopsy point in series X  =  volumeTreference_X @ plans.LPS\n")

# geometry for voxel mapping
def geo(snum):
    dss=[pydicom.dcmread(f,stop_before_pixels=True) for f in by_series[snum]]
    d0=dss[0]
    iop=np.array(list(d0.ImageOrientationPatient),float).reshape(2,3)
    r,c=iop[0],iop[1]; n=np.cross(r,c); n/=np.linalg.norm(n)
    px,py=[float(x) for x in d0.PixelSpacing]; ss=float(d0.SliceThickness)
    return r,c,n,px,py,ss

def arr_of(snum):
    dss=[pydicom.dcmread(f) for f in by_series[snum]]
    dss.sort(key=lambda d:d.InstanceNumber)

    sub=arr[lo[0]:hi[0],lo[1]:hi[1],lo[2]:hi[2]]
